works.title: The Works of Saint Cyril of Jerusalem, Vol. 1
works.subtitle: Procatechesis and Catecheses 1–12 (Fathers of the Church, Vol. 61)
works.author: Cyril of Jerusalem
works.publisher: The Catholic University of America Press
works.blurb: Cyril's pre-baptismal catechetical lectures to fourth-century catechumens in Jerusalem, what the candidates for Pascha were taught about sin, repentance, the creed, and the Scriptures. McCauley and Stephenson translation.

works.title: The Works of Saint Cyril of Jerusalem, Vol. 2
works.subtitle: Catecheses 13–18 and the Five Mystagogical Catecheses (Fathers of the Church, Vol. 64)
works.author: Cyril of Jerusalem
works.publisher: The Catholic University of America Press
works.blurb: The remaining Lenten catecheses and the post-baptismal Mystagogical lectures, Cyril leading the newly-illumined through Baptism, Chrismation, and the Eucharist. The earliest extant Christian mystagogy.
